name: Conversation in Autumn
material: Hanging scroll; ink and light color on paper
summary: Two figures sit conversing in a thatched cottage. This painting illustrates two poetic lines:My guest came to sit beyond the dust, In a narrow room, we talked about the autumnal sounds of autumn.
